_meta.source: quran_finance_layer.json v1 gap list - Adam approved all 14; NT08/09/10/14 assigned to F12 social finance per Adam.
_meta.merge_instruction: Append these rows to terms.json rows[] at final assembly (Step G). Verse refs live in quran_finance_layer.json via quran_layer_id.
_meta.dating_note: earliest_date_ce deliberately 'undated' - Qur'an is never dated (rule 3).

rows.definition: Any stipulated excess on a loan or unequal exchange of like commodities; parent of riba al-fadl (T022) and riba al-nasi'ah (T023).
rows.modern_usage: Bedrock prohibition; every product screen tests against it.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Idle accumulation of monetary wealth outside circulation (9:34-35); distinct from ihtikar/market cornering (T158).
rows.modern_usage: Anti-idle-money argument for investment over cash piles.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Wasteful spending beyond need (17:26-27; 25:67); consumption has a floor and a ceiling.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Giving less than promised in measure or weight (83:1-3; 11:84-85).
rows.modern_usage: Disclosure integrity; spec precision in salam/istisna; audit rationale.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Taking others' wealth without right (2:188; 4:29); all transfer must be by trade, gift or inheritance.
rows.modern_usage: Root of void/voidable contract doctrine and anti-fraud clauses.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Tainted earnings - bribes and forbidden income (5:42; 5:62-63).
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Broadest Qur'anic word for directing wealth to good (2:261; 2:271); wider than sadaqah (T118).
rows.modern_usage: Umbrella for social-impact deployment of wealth.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Fixed fractional estate shares (4:11-12; 4:176), payable AFTER debts and bequest.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Testamentary gift, classically capped at one-third, before shares divide (2:180; 5:106).
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Obligatory wealth transfer to the wife as her independent property (4:4); deferred mahr functions as a debt.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: Guardianship duty over others' property 'in the best way' (4:2; 17:34); the fiduciary core.
rows.modern_usage: Trustee and fund-manager duty framing; investment agency ethics.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: The general permission of sale and trade by mutual consent (2:275; 4:29); parent of all bay' sub-types.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: 2:282 mandates writing debts, faithful dictation, witnesses, terms - the Qur'an's own paperwork standard.
rows.modern_usage: Ancestor of disclosure, contract documentation and auditability.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.

rows.definition: State-revenue words: jizyah (9:29), khums of gains (8:41), fay' with the anti-concentration clause (59:7).
rows.modern_usage: Historical tier; sovereign/public Islamic finance framing.
rows.added_note: Minted 2026-07-05 from quran_finance_layer NT set, Adam-approved.
